services.name: Parks & Campgrounds
services.desc: Skamania County Public Works and Events & Recreation departments maintain and operate several community parks and campgrounds throughout the county that are available for use/rent by public agencies and private individuals. We strive to provide quality open space, including trails, play structures and picnic shelters. We can accommodate business/public meetings, weddings, receptions, family gatherings and more. Large scale commercial events can be held on the Skamania County Fairgrounds, including livestock and agricultural events, music festivals and expositions. Interested in being a Camp Host?
